prompt: A system administrator wants to mount a Samba share named Backup located on the server smb-server. They also need to provide a username admin and password secretpass during the mount process. Which command should they use to mount the share to the directory `/mnt/backup`?
explanation: CIFS shares are mounted with `mount -t cifs`; credentials are supplied via the `-o` `username=` and `password=` options.
